notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Insects.
description:
Activate Staff of Domination's last ability by paying {5} and tapping it, causing yourself to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, causing you to add at least six {C}.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
